title.narrative: Shaanxi Mountain Road Safety Demonstration Project

description.narrative: The project will improve accessibility and road safety by (i) upgrading and introducing safety treatments on trunk and rural roads in the hazardous Qinba Mountains area in southeast Shaanxi, (ii) implementing a crash reduction program involving only road safety treatments on other hazardous rural roads, and (iii) strengthening road safety design and management practices and introducing road safety education and community awareness programs.
